label: presence-negative-controls
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM
 (VALUES ('{}',false),('{"107":null}',true),('{"107":true}',true),('malformed',true)) AS cases(input,expected)
 WHERE coalesce(array_contains(json_object_keys(input),'107'),true) <> expected

label: affected-full-carrier-parity
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 1 WHERE entity_version=1 AND apply_batch_id='r89') a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0) s
 ON a.source_system=s.source_system AND a.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND a.id=s.id
 WHERE a.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_system,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.source_system,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.rel_type_id <=> s.rel_type_id) OR NOT (a.id <=> s.id) OR NOT (a.source_type <=> s.source_type) OR NOT (a.source_id <=> s.source_id) OR NOT (a.target_type <=> s.target_type) OR NOT (a.target_id <=> s.target_id) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.schema_revision,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.schema_revision,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.entity_version <=> s.entity_version) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.props_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.retained_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.retained_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.order_key,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.order_key,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_feed,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.source_feed,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_epoch,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.source_epoch,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.source_position <=> s.source_position) OR NOT (a.published_at <=> s.published_at) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.lookup_hash,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.lookup_hash,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.apply_batch_id,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.source_cursor_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(s.source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')))

label: narrow-key-prior-property-preservation
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(k) */ b.source_system,b.rel_type_id,b.id,b.props_json FROM
 client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 0 b JOIN (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0) k ON b.source_system=k.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=k.rel_type_id AND b.id=k.id) b
 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0) s ON b.source_system=s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND b.id=s.id
 WHERE b.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL OR
 NOT (hex(encode(s.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('{"107":true',CASE WHEN b.props_json='{}' THEN '}' ELSE concat(',',substring(b.props_json,2)) END),'UTF-8')))
 OR coalesce(array_contains(json_object_keys(b.props_json),'107'),true)
